summary: Feature implemented without committing. Added monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver), plot_2d_or_3d_image in monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py, and changed the NIfTI writer default dtype to np.float32. Rewrote SegmentationSaver, ClassificationSaver (engine-accepting _finalize wrapper), and TensorBoardImageHandler (new index parameter) as thin adapters. Updated the two segmentation examples, the sliding-window integration test, and the classification handler test. Added tests test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, and test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py. Verification was by reading and grep only: no tests, flake8, or ignite attach were run. Line length, trailing whitespace, and file endings were checked by grep, and one extra trailing blank line in tensorboard_handlers.py was fixed. Running pytest and flake8 on the changed files is the next step.
